signals.title: AI/data-center growth remains supportive
signals.detail: Recent reported results show very strong data-center demand and profitability. Treat as thesis-supporting evidence, not a reason to chase price.

signals.title: Leading-edge and AI/HPC demand remains supportive
signals.detail: Recent operating performance and management commentary continue to support the long-term foundry thesis.

signals.title: Chinese AI accelerators are a watch item
signals.detail: Domestic Chinese accelerator development is progressing. This matters mainly if it translates into durable share loss, weaker economics or ecosystem erosion.

signals.title: Geopolitical concentration remains a standing risk
signals.detail: Taiwan concentration is part of the thesis risk profile and should be monitored separately from normal business fundamentals.

signals.title: AI infrastructure demand remains a supportive industry signal
signals.detail: Semiconductor demand remains supported by AI infrastructure spending, while cyclicality and valuation remain watch items.

signals.title: Growth concentration warrants monitoring
signals.detail: Technology-heavy exposure can amplify valuation and concentration risk even when the underlying businesses remain strong.

signals.title: US concentration is intentional but overlapping
signals.detail: VOO remains a core holding, but its exposure overlaps with QQQ and the semiconductor satellites.

signals.title: Global diversification remains intact
signals.detail: VWRA continues to serve as the broad geographic foundation of the portfolio.
